achievements.name: Disciple of Planned Economy
achievements.description: Play any single game for at least 2 game years

achievements.name: Republic Founder
achievements.description: Complete all missions from the first campaign.

achievements.name: Revolutionary of the Republic
achievements.description: Complete all missions from the second campaign.

achievements.name: Master of Research
achievements.description: Complete all possible researches (in a single game).

achievements.name: Trabi Maker
achievements.description: Manufacture and sell 100 Trabi personal cars to western countries (in a single game).

achievements.name: Soviet Society
achievements.description: Achieve a population of 25,000 citizens with at least 70% average happiness without inviting immigrants in the last 2 years.

achievements.name: Soviet Paradise
achievements.description: Achieve a population of 50,000 citizens with at least 80% average happiness without inviting immigrants in the last 2 years.

achievements.name: Cableway Lover
achievements.description: Operate at least 10 working cableways in one game.

achievements.name: Nature Lover
achievements.description: Produce at least 1,000 tons of plastic waste from separation (in a single game).

achievements.name: Waste Incinerator
achievements.description: Produce at least 1,000 tons of ash in incinerators (in a single game).

achievements.name: Wrong Communist
achievements.description: Achieve at least 80% religious sympathy with at least 20,000 citizens.

achievements.name: Right Communist
achievements.description: Achieve at least 80% alcohol addiction with at least 10,000 citizens.

achievements.name: Soviet Airways
achievements.description: Operate 5 airplanes to western or eastern countries.

achievements.name: Nuclear Manufacturer
achievements.description: Produce 10 tons of nuclear fuel in realistic mode.

achievements.name: Soviet Republic Expert
achievements.description: Achieve a population of 30,000 citizens on the hardest difficulty, without inviting immigrants in the last 10 years.
